papers.title: A new Fight-or-Flight Pacemaker Mechanism via Ryanodine Receptor abundance and superclustering.
papers.abstract: The sinoatrial node is the primary cardiac pacemaker. Individual sinoatrial node cells (SANCs) generate spontaneous rhythmic action potentials (APs) that initiate each heartbeat. The mechanism of SANC automaticity and its modulation by autonomic nervous system is based on the coupled function of molecules of both the cell membrane (ion channels, exchangers, and pumps) and the sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR), which generates rhythmic local Ca releases (LCRs). While LCRs are generated by ryanodine receptors (RyRs), the molecular-scale RyR network structure remains unknown. Here we performed single-molecule localization of RyRs via direct Stochastic Optical Reconstruction Microscopy (dSTORM) in rabbit SANCs in basal conditions and 5 minutes after β-adrenergic receptor (βAR) stimulation by isoproterenol. RyRs form clusters of various sizes, with a mean density of 67.7 ± 13.2 RyR/μm2. (mean±SEM, n = 6 cells). While the majority of cluster sizes ranged from 3 to 32 RyRs, each cell had a few substantially larger clusters (>76 RyRs), dubbed superclusters. βAR stimulation significantly increased the RyR density to 119.1 ± 22.6 RyR/μm2 (8 cells, p ≤ 0.05) and created more superclusters. Our numerical SANC model showed that superclustering substantially decreased the AP cycle length (APCL) by creating Ca release hotspots that initiated larger LCRs under any condition. Increasing RyR density prolonged APCL in the basal state but shortened APCL during βAR stimulation. With no change in RyR network, βAR stimulation of only SR Ca pump and ion currents shortened APCL on average from 414.9 to 284 ms. When realistic higher RyR density and superclustering were added to the model, APCL further shortened to 231.9 ms. Thus, dynamic nanoscale changes in RyR network provide a new powerful pacemaker mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 窦房结是心脏的主要起搏器。单个窦房结细胞（SANC）产生自发节律性动作电位，启动每一次心跳。SANC自律性及其受自主神经系统调节的机制，基于细胞膜分子（离子通道、交换体和泵）和肌浆网（SR）的偶联功能，后者产生节律性局部Ca释放（LCR）。虽然LCR由兰尼碱受体（RyRs）产生，但分子尺度上的RyR网络结构仍不清楚。在此，我们通过直接随机光学重建显微镜（dSTORM）对兔SANC在基础条件和β-肾上腺素受体（βAR）刺激（异丙肾上腺素处理5分钟）后的RyR进行单分子定位。RyR形成大小不等的簇，平均密度为67.7 ± 13.2 RyR/μm²（平均值±SEM，n=6个细胞）。虽然大多数簇的大小在3到32个RyR之间，但每个细胞都有少数明显更大的簇（>76 RyR），称为超级簇。βAR刺激显著增加了RyR密度至119.1 ± 22.6 RyR/μm²（8个细胞，p≤0.05），并产生了更多的超级簇。我们的SANC数值模型显示，在任何条件下，超级簇化通过创建Ca释放热点，引发更大的LCR，从而显著缩短动作电位周期长度（APCL）。在基础状态下，增加RyR密度延长了APCL，但在βAR刺激期间缩短了APCL。在RyR网络无变化的情况下，仅βAR对SR钙泵和离子流的刺激使APCL平均从414.9 ms缩短至284 ms。当将实际的更高RyR密度和超级簇化加入模型时，APCL进一步缩短至231.9 ms。因此，RyR网络的动态纳米尺度变化提供了一种新的强大起搏机制。
key_findings: 发现RyR在窦房结细胞中形成簇和超级簇，β-肾上腺素刺激增加其密度和超级簇数量。
超级簇通过产生钙释放热点引发更大的局部钙释放，从而显著缩短动作电位周期。
动态RyR网络重塑（密度和超级簇化）为心脏起搏提供了新的调节机制，加速心率。

papers.title: A Linear Mixed Effects Model for Evaluating Synthetic Gene Circuits.
papers.abstract: One significant advancement in synthetic biology is the development of synthetic gene circuits with predictive Boolean logic. However, there is no universally accepted or applied statistical test to analyze the performance of these circuits. Many basic statistical tests fail to account for the predicted logic (OR, AND, etc.), and many studies neglect statistical analysis entirely. As synthetic gene circuits shift toward advanced applications, primarily in computing, biosensing, and human health, it is critical to standardize the statistical methods used to evaluate gate success. Here, we propose the application of a linear mixed effects model to analyze and quantify genetic Boolean logic gate performance. First, we analyzed 144 currently published Boolean logic gates for emergent trends with unsupervised machine learning (k-means clustering). We then simulated data representative of the centroid of each k-means cluster. Next, we utilized a linear mixed effects model to estimate the Boolean nature of a circuit, where the fixed effect β represents the difference between the ON and OFF states, and the random effect is the input grouping (i.e.,+/-, +/+). We first validated this model on the simulated data and used Monte Carlo simulations to recommend sample sizes for evaluating gate performance. We then evaluated point estimates of the fixed effect, β̂, as a holistic metric for circuit performance using a series of nested repressor OR gates with intentionally degraded performance. We observed an association between β̂ and the predicted translation rate, and used β̂ to guide the design of a 3-input gate, highlighting the potential use of this modeling approach for the forward design of new Boolean gates. Finally, we extended our analysis to multi-input (>2) and multi-output gates, emphasizing that the linear mixed effects model can be applied for higher-order logic. In summary, we utilized a linear mixed effects model to evaluate synthetic gene circuits and determined that point estimates of the fixed effect, β̂, are appropriate descriptors of gate behavior that can be used to statistically evaluate performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 合成生物学的一项重大进展是开发具有可预测布尔逻辑的合成基因电路。然而，尚无普遍接受或应用的统计检验来分析这些电路的性能。许多基本统计检验未能考虑预测的逻辑（或、与等），且许多研究完全忽略统计分析。随着合成基因电路转向高级应用，尤其是在计算、生物传感和人类健康领域，标准化评估逻辑门成功与否的统计方法至关重要。在此，我们提出应用线性混合效应模型（LMM）来分析和量化遗传布尔逻辑门的性能。首先，我们通过无监督机器学习（k均值聚类）分析了144个已发表的布尔逻辑门以揭示新兴趋势。然后，我们模拟了代表每个k均值聚类质心的数据。接着，利用线性混合效应模型估计电路的布尔特性，其中固定效应 β 表示开启与关闭状态之间的差异，随机效应为输入分组（即 +/-, +/+）。我们首先在模拟数据上验证了该模型，并使用蒙特卡洛模拟推荐了评估门性能所需的样本量。随后，我们通过一系列嵌套抑制子或门（性能人为降低）评估了固定效应点估计值 β̂ 作为衡量电路性能的整体指标。我们观察到 β̂ 与预测翻译速率之间存在关联，并利用 β̂ 指导了三输入门的设计，突显了该建模方法用于新布尔门前向设计的潜力。最后，我们将分析扩展至多输入（>2）和多输出门，强调线性混合效应模型可应用于高阶逻辑。总之，我们利用线性混合效应模型评估合成基因电路，确定固定效应点估计值 β̂ 是描述门行为的合适指标，可用于统计评估性能。
key_findings: 提出线性混合效应模型，以固定效应点估计β̂作为全面量化基因电路布尔逻辑性能的指标。
通过模拟数据与蒙特卡洛方法验证模型，并确定评估逻辑门性能所需的最佳样本量。
发现β̂与预测翻译速率关联，可指导多输入门的前向设计，模型适用于高阶逻辑电路。
